methodology.runDefinition: one wf_*.json session-sidecar file, i.e. one Workflow tool invocation
methodology.agentDefinition: one workflow_agent entry inside a run's workflowProgress[]
knownLimits: totalTokens / workflowProgress[].tokens (the sidecar 'tokens' field) is not a cost basis - see reconciliation.reviewVsImplement
a cached:true agent is genuinely zero-cost and correctly contributes 0 to every class

an agent with no agentId, no transcript file, or an empty transcript falls back to the sidecar-only tokens scalar attributed entirely to output (lossy fallback, 10 agents in this run set - see warnings)

the CLI's --format json does not expose per-run enumeration or the first-request/regression floor analysis; both were derived by importing scripts/lib/token-report.mjs's exported functions directly and cross-checked against the CLI's own aggregate output

included.exclusionRule: a run's workflowName field must exact-match one of the six lane names: autopilot, dispatch-phase, plan-review, backlog, estimate, document

surveyClaim.source: roadmap body 'Why' section, original scratchpad survey of 20 runs, non-cost-basis tokens field

old.methodology: sidecar tokens field, this phase's 40-run set

legacyRegression.description: sidecar tokens field vs toolCalls, reproducing the original survey's method

correctedRegression.description: deduped cache-read-inclusive total vs toolCalls, same method applied to corrected totals
correctedRegression.note: intercept is negative and not usable as a floor - relationship is super-linear once cache reads are counted, so a linear regression forced through the curvature breaks

measuredFloor.description: median of each agent's first transcript request only (uncachedInput + cacheWrite + cacheRead, before any tool use)

remainderToolSchemasSystemPrompt.basis: estimated (derived: measured floor minus estimated CLAUDE.md subtotal)

attribution.tokenizerNote: no local Anthropic tokenizer was available; CLAUDE.md token figures use the ~4-chars-per-token English-prose approximation applied to a directly measured character count

confounds: roadmap size - a roadmap with more phases dispatches more dispatch-phase/plan-review/estimate agent invocations inside a single autopilot run; larger roadmap does not imply a more expensive phase
phase difficulty / model tier - rdm-estimate assigns each phase a difficulty and model tier; a high-tier phase's agents run on a more expensive model and do not necessarily use fewer tokens for it

rework rounds - a phase that bounces through plan-review or code-review rework re-runs find/refute/plan/implement agents multiple times; its total is not comparable to a phase that passed on the first pass

user-specific CLAUDE.md - the user-global CLAUDE.md measured for the context floor is this operator's own machine; a different operator's global instructions file will shift the floor by a different amount

model-identity drift - some agent records carry a generic alias (haiku, sonnet) rather than a resolved snapshot ID and contribute zero measurable usage; per-model comparisons must key on the exact snapshot ID
run completeness - 3 of 19 autopilot runs in scope are killed and 4 are failed (0 agents)
comparableUnit: per-agent-class figures and per-phase-dispatch figures; raw per-run totals are not a valid comparison unit for later phases' before/after claims

noBehaviorChange.statement: measurement and documentation only; no file under .claude/workflows/, .claude/workflows/lib/, .claude/skills/, scripts/measure-lane-tokens.mjs, or scripts/lib/token-report.mjs was modified by this phase's commit
